title: claude-kit plugin manifest
description: Shape of plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json. Mirrored by scripts/validate.mjs, which is the enforcing copy.

name.description: Must equal the directory name and the marketplace.json entry name.

version.description: The only update trigger. Bump it or `claude plugin update` is a no-op.

hooks.description: Only for EXTRA hook files. hooks/hooks.json is auto-loaded; naming it here makes the plugin fail to load.

externalSkills.description: Skills an agent references that are not shipped in this repo. Key is the skill name, value is why.
